author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: यन्निश्श्रेयसकरत्वमुक्तं तदुपपाद्यते ॥  बाह्येति ।  संसारेऽप्यात्मस्मरणरूपाल्प-योगयुक्तः संन्यासी सुखं विन्दति यदा तदा ध्यानादिमहायोगादियुक्तो मोक्षादिनिश्श्रेयसं विन्दतीति किमु वाच्यमित्यर्थः
translation: Contacts: should be taken in the sense of the objects with which the senses core in contact. One should endeavour to prevent them from being presented to the senses. When they are presented his mind should feel no attachment to them. That is, such & one is a Sanyasin. In his self : in his essential state. It would have been sufficient to say what...... he feels. But the addition of in his self (Atmani) is intended to show that even Atman is not destitute of peculiarities or essential attributes which can be abstracted and spoken of separately as the property of anything else.
